outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative super-resolution micrographs/density maps/cluster segmentations, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows representative super-resolution micrographs/density maps/cluster segmentations, not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of proportion of clustered molecules per cell showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows representative super-resolution localization/trajectory images, not a plot of averaged data.

Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients (distribution itself shows all data) and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement traces per molecule; neither is a bar/mean plot requiring overlaid individual points, and line plots/histograms are exempt.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph, not a plot of averaged summary statistics.
